adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `destinationCalendar` as an array and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now loops over each destination and calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`. However, `CalendarManager.createEvent` ignores its new `externalId` parameter when calling the integration (`calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)`), and several non-Google implementations (e.g. Lark/Office/BaseCalendarService) explicitly select only the first destination calendar (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []; const calendarId = mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId;`). This means when creating events for multiple destination calendars, those integrations will still create/update against the first destination calendar rather than the intended per-destination calendar, producing incorrect calendar placement.
